tools.name: save_ride
tools.description: Upsert one of the caller's rides as domain records (ride request plus its driver, vehicle, quote, assignment, trip, trip status event and transition history; trip status only moves forward). Idempotent: ids are derived from the client ride, so replaying the same ride changes nothing.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO riders (id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :__now, :__now)

INSERT INTO drivers (rider_id, id, display_name, rating, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :driver_id, :driver_name, :driver_rating, 'active', :__now, :__now WHERE :driver_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, rating = COALESCE(excluded.rating, drivers.rating), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO vehicles (rider_id, id, driver_id, plate, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :vehicle_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_plate, :vehicle_class, :__now, :__now WHERE :vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_class = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_class, vehicles.vehicle_class), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO ride_requests (rider_id, id, booking_type, status, pickup_label, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, dropoff_label, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng, recurring_days, pickup_time, scheduled_for, vehicle_class, requested_at, client_record, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :request_id, :booking_type, :request_status, :pickup_label, :pickup_lat, :pickup_lng, :dropoff_label, :dropoff_lat, :dropoff_lng, :recurring_days, :pickup_time, :scheduled_for, :vehicle_class, :requested_at, :client_record, :created_at, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET booking_type = excluded.booking_type, status = excluded.status, pickup_label = excluded.pickup_label, pickup_lat = excluded.pickup_lat, pickup_lng = excluded.pickup_lng, dropoff_label = excluded.dropoff_label, dropoff_lat = excluded.dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng = excluded.dropoff_lng, recurring_days = excluded.recurring_days, pickup_time = excluded.pickup_time, scheduled_for = excluded.scheduled_for, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, requested_at = excluded.requested_at, client_record = excluded.client_record, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO quotes (rider_id, id, request_id, vehicle_class, fare_cents, eta_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :quote_id, :request_id, :vehicle_class, :fare_cents, :eta_minutes, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :quote_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, fare_cents = excluded.fare_cents, eta_minutes = excluded.eta_minutes, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO assignments (rider_id, id, request_id, driver_id, vehicle_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :assignment_id, :request_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_id, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :assignment_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_id = excluded.vehicle_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, CASE WHEN c.cur = :trip_status THEN NULL ELSE c.cur END, :trip_status, 'rider', :__user_id, '{"source":"save_ride"}', :__now FROM (SELECT (SELECT t.status FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.id = :trip_id) AS cur) c WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.cur IS NULL OR c.cur = :trip_status OR (c.cur IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND CASE :trip_status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END > CASE c.cur WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END))

INSERT INTO trips (rider_id, id, request_id, assignment_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_id, :request_id, :assignment_id, :trip_status, :__now, :__now WHERE :trip_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET assignment_id = excluded.assignment_id, status = CASE WHEN trips.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND CASE excluded.status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END > CASE trips.status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END THEN excluded.status ELSE trips.status END, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, 'status', :trip_status, :__now WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status = :trip_status)

tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.description: Cancel one of the caller's ride requests and any unfinished trip for it
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT :__user_id, t.id || ':' || 'cancelled', t.id, t.status, 'cancelled', 'rider', :__user_id, '{"source":"cancel_ride"}', :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT :__user_id, t.id || ':' || 'cancelled', t.id, 'status', 'cancelled', :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
UPDATE ride_requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND id = :request_id
UPDATE trips SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')

tools.name: list_ride_requests
tools.description: List the caller's ride requests, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, booking_type, status, pickup_label, dropoff_label, recurring_days, pickup_time, scheduled_for, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at FROM ride_requests WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: advance_trip
tools.description: Driver action: move a trip assigned to the caller's driver account one step (scheduled -> en_route -> arrived -> completed) or cancel it. Invalid transitions, unassigned trips and other drivers' trips change nothing. Records actor, time and optional metadata in trip_transitions.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id || ':' || :to_status, t.id, t.status, :to_status, 'driver', :__user_id, :metadata, :__now FROM trips t JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status IN ('en_route', 'cancelled')) OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status IN ('arrived', 'cancelled')) OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status IN ('completed', 'cancelled')))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT x.rider_id, x.trip_id || ':' || x.to_status, x.trip_id, 'status', x.to_status, x.at FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = :rider_id AND x.trip_id = :trip_id AND x.to_status = :to_status AND x.actor_id = :__user_id

UPDATE trips SET status = :to_status, updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND id = :trip_id AND ((trips.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status IN ('en_route', 'cancelled')) OR (trips.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status IN ('arrived', 'cancelled')) OR (trips.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status IN ('completed', 'cancelled'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = trips.rider_id AND a.id = trips.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id)

UPDATE ride_requests SET status = CASE WHEN :to_status = 'completed' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'cancelled' END, updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND :to_status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND id = (SELECT t.request_id FROM trips t JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id AND t.status = :to_status)

tools.name: list_my_trips
tools.description: List the caller's trips as a rider, newest first, optionally filtered by status
tools.sql: SELECT t.id, t.request_id, t.assignment_id, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR t.status = :status) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_my_trip_history
tools.description: The caller's append-only transition history for one of their trips, oldest first (who moved it, when, and metadata)
tools.sql: SELECT id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at FROM trip_transitions WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND trip_id = :trip_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: list_driver_trips
tools.description: List trips assigned to the caller's linked driver account, newest first, optionally filtered by status
tools.sql: SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, t.request_id, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label, r.scheduled_for FROM trips t JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE d.user_id = :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR t.status = :status) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_driver_trip_history
tools.description: Transition history for one trip assigned to the caller's linked driver account, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT x.id, x.from_status, x.to_status, x.actor_type, x.metadata, x.at FROM trip_transitions x JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = x.rider_id AND t.id = x.trip_id JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE x.rider_id = :rider_id AND x.trip_id = :trip_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY x.at, x.rowid

tools.name: get_rider_profile
tools.description: The caller's rider profile and contact preferences (no row until first saved)
tools.sql: SELECT display_name, phone, notify_email, notify_sms, notify_trip_updates, updated_at FROM rider_profiles WHERE rider_id = :__user_id

tools.name: save_rider_profile
tools.description: Create or update the caller's rider profile and contact preferences
tools.sql: INSERT INTO rider_profiles (rider_id, display_name, phone, notify_email, notify_sms, notify_trip_updates, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :display_name, :phone, :notify_email, :notify_sms, :notify_trip_updates, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, phone = excluded.phone, notify_email = excluded.notify_email, notify_sms = excluded.notify_sms, notify_trip_updates = excluded.notify_trip_updates, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: list_saved_places
tools.description: List the caller's saved places (Home, Work, ...)
tools.sql: SELECT id, label, address, lat, lng, created_at FROM saved_places WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: save_place
tools.description: Create or update one of the caller's saved places
tools.sql: INSERT INTO saved_places (rider_id, id, label, address, lat, lng, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :place_id, :label, :address, :lat, :lng, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET label = excluded.label, address = excluded.address, lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: delete_place
tools.description: Delete one of the caller's saved places
tools.sql: DELETE FROM saved_places WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND id = :place_id

tools.name: list_trip_history
tools.description: The caller's ride requests with trip status and fare, newest activity first. Client groups them into active, scheduled, completed and cancelled.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id, r.booking_type, r.status, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label, r.recurring_days, r.pickup_time, r.scheduled_for, r.vehicle_class, r.created_at, r.updated_at, t.status AS trip_status, q.fare_cents FROM ride_requests r LEFT JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = r.rider_id AND t.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN quotes q ON q.rider_id = r.rider_id AND q.request_id = r.id WHERE r.rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: export_ride_requests
tools.description: Data export: every ride request the caller owns, including the stored client record
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM ride_requests WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: export_trips
tools.description: Data export: every trip the caller owns
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM trips WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: export_trip_transitions
tools.description: Data export: the full trip transition history for the caller's trips
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM trip_transitions WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: delete_my_rider_data
tools.description: Erase everything the caller owns as a rider (profile, saved places, requests, quotes, assignments, trips, history, drivers and vehicles they recorded) and unlink the caller's driver account. Irreversible.
statements: DELETE FROM trip_transitions WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM trip_events WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM trips WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM assignments WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM quotes WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM vehicles WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM drivers WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM ride_requests WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM saved_places WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM rider_profiles WHERE rider_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM riders WHERE id = :__user_id
UPDATE drivers SET user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: get_my_driver_application
tools.description: The caller's own driver application, status and the reason for the last decision (no row until started)
tools.sql: SELECT status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, status_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at, updated_at FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: save_driver_application
tools.description: Create or edit the caller's driver application (profile, licence and eligibility). Only while it is a draft or was rejected; submitted, approved and suspended applications are locked. Licence details are private: visible only to the applicant and ops.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO driver_applications (user_id, status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, 'draft', :full_name, :phone, :licence_number, :licence_region, :licence_expires, :eligibility_confirmed, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET full_name = excluded.full_name, phone = excluded.phone, licence_number = excluded.licence_number, licence_region = excluded.licence_region, licence_expires = excluded.licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed = excluded.eligibility_confirmed, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE driver_applications.status IN ('draft', 'rejected')

tools.name: list_my_driver_vehicles
tools.description: The caller's vehicles with their approval status and reason
tools.sql: SELECT id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, status_reason FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at

tools.name: save_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Add or edit one of the caller's vehicles. Changing any detail of an existing vehicle sends it back to pending review and takes the driver off dispatch if it was the active vehicle.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_vehicles (user_id, id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :vehicle_id, :plate, :make, :model, :year, :colour, :seats, :vehicle_class, 'pending', :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (user_id, id) DO UPDATE SET status = CASE WHEN driver_vehicles.plate IS excluded.plate AND driver_vehicles.make IS excluded.make AND driver_vehicles.model IS excluded.model AND driver_vehicles.year IS excluded.year AND driver_vehicles.colour IS excluded.colour AND driver_vehicles.seats IS excluded.seats AND driver_vehicles.vehicle_class IS excluded.vehicle_class THEN driver_vehicles.status ELSE 'pending' END, plate = excluded.plate, make = excluded.make, model = excluded.model, year = excluded.year, colour = excluded.colour, seats = excluded.seats, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :__user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status = 'approved')

tools.name: delete_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Remove one of the caller's vehicles (and take the driver off dispatch if it was the active vehicle)
statements: UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id
DELETE FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND id = :vehicle_id

tools.name: submit_driver_application
tools.description: Submit the caller's application for review. Needs name, phone, licence number/region/expiry, confirmed eligibility and at least one vehicle. Only from draft or rejected. Audited.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, 'submitted', NULL, :__user_id, 'applicant', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND a.full_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.full_name) != '' AND a.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.phone) != '' AND a.licence_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_number) != '' AND a.licence_region IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_region) != '' AND a.licence_expires IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_expires) != '' AND a.eligibility_confirmed = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = a.user_id)

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = 'submitted', status_reason = NULL, submitted_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND status IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND full_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(full_name) != '' AND phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(phone) != '' AND licence_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_number) != '' AND licence_region IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_region) != '' AND licence_expires IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_expires) != '' AND eligibility_confirmed = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = driver_applications.user_id)

tools.name: list_my_driver_review_log
tools.description: The audit trail of decisions on the caller's application and vehicles, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_role, at FROM driver_review_log WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: get_my_driver_availability
tools.description: Whether the caller is currently available for dispatch, and with which vehicle
tools.sql: SELECT available, vehicle_id, updated_at FROM driver_availability WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: set_driver_availability
tools.description: Go on or off dispatch. Going available only works for an approved (not suspended) driver with an unexpired licence and an approved vehicle; otherwise nothing changes. Going unavailable always works.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO driver_availability (user_id, available, vehicle_id, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :available, :vehicle_id, :__now WHERE :available = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status = 'approved') ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET available = excluded.available, vehicle_id = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_id, driver_availability.vehicle_id), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: list_driver_applications
tools.description: Ops: driver applications, oldest submission first, optionally by status. Licence number is masked to its last 4 characters. Excludes the caller's own application.
tools.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.status, a.full_name, a.phone, substr(a.licence_number, -4) AS licence_last4, a.licence_region, a.licence_expires, a.submitted_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = a.user_id) AS vehicle_count FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id != :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR a.status = :status) ORDER BY a.submitted_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_driver_application_detail
tools.description: Ops: one application in full, including the licence number, for verification
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, status_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id

tools.name: list_driver_vehicles_for_review
tools.description: Ops: a driver's vehicles
tools.sql: SELECT id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, status_reason FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id ORDER BY created_at

tools.name: list_driver_review_log
tools.description: Ops: the audit trail for one driver (who decided what, when and why), oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at FROM driver_review_log WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: review_driver_application
tools.description: Ops: decide an application. submitted -> approved|rejected, approved -> suspended, suspended -> approved. Rejecting and suspending need a reason. Approving from submitted also approves the driver's pending vehicles; rejecting or suspending takes the driver off dispatch. Cannot review your own application. Every decision is audited with actor and reason; an invalid move changes nothing.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, :decision, :reason, :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (a.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (a.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_vehicles SET status = 'approved', status_reason = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND status = 'pending' AND :decision = 'approved' AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (a.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (a.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0) AND a.status = 'submitted')

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND :decision IN ('rejected', 'suspended') AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (a.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (a.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0))

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = :decision, status_reason = CASE WHEN :decision = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE trim(:reason) END, reviewed_at = :__now, reviewed_by = :__user_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND ((driver_applications.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (driver_applications.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'suspended') OR (driver_applications.status = 'suspended' AND :decision = 'approved')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

tools.name: review_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Ops: approve or reject one vehicle (pending -> approved|rejected, approved -> rejected). Rejecting needs a reason and takes the driver off dispatch if it was their active vehicle. Audited.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, v.user_id, v.id, v.status, :decision, :reason, :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :driver_user_id AND v.user_id != :__user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND ((v.status = 'pending' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (v.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'rejected')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id AND :decision = 'rejected' AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :driver_user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_vehicles SET status = :decision, status_reason = CASE WHEN :decision = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE trim(:reason) END, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND id = :vehicle_id AND ((status = 'pending' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'rejected')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

tools.name: list_dispatchable_drivers
tools.description: Ops/dispatch: drivers who are available right now AND still approved, with an approved vehicle and an unexpired licence. Suspension, rejection or licence expiry removes a driver here even if their availability flag is stale.
tools.sql: SELECT d.user_id, a.full_name, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.plate, v.vehicle_class, v.seats FROM driver_availability d JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = d.user_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = d.user_id AND v.id = d.vehicle_id WHERE d.available = 1 AND a.status = 'approved' AND v.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.updated_at LIMIT :limit
